about_blocks.text: Westminster House Society is a trauma-informed, gender-specific addiction recovery program that has been serving women and youth girls since 1981. The program utilizes the biopsychosocial model and complemented by cognitive behavioural therapy, introspective writing, and motivational interviewing to provide a broad range of services to the clients. The treatment services are delivered both residentially and virtually to ensure that women from Western Canada and beyond can access the services.

about_blocks.text: The society offers addiction recovery services for youth girls, adult women, and their families. Westminster House is a non-profit charity organization that employs the best-cost strategy to provide upscale, multidisciplinary, and community-based services to provide a high value of service at an affordable price. The program has both private and publicly funded options available. Through Facebook, interested parties can learn more and see the successes.

about_blocks.text: Westminster House is an addiction-free environment and supports women to permanently stop using substances, including nicotine, alcohol, and prescription and illicit drugs and process addictions. The program is regarded as one of Vancouver’s best drug rehab centres due to their approach to helping women overcome their addictions with the use of holistic treatment.

about_blocks.text: At Westminster House, the goal is not only to facilitate addiction recovery but also to help women build resilience so that they may overcome the effects of trauma and addiction and reclaim their lives in their treatment centre in Vancouver. The approach adopted by Westminster House is effective as evidenced by the success stories that many women who have graduated have shared.

about_blocks.text: Westminster House is a residential drug rehab center offering evidence-based practices and holistic therapies to female adults who are recovering from addiction. The center has been providing a safe and supportive environment for women for over three decades and is one of the few residential recovery centers in British Columbia. With its personalized “holistic” recovery model and principles from the 12-step approach, Westminster House is dedicated to empowering women to take responsibility for their ongoing recovery process.

about_blocks.text: The center’s recovery program provides clients with the necessary tools to overcome addiction and trust their own ability to reclaim a drug-free existence. Westminster House strongly encourages family members to participate in educational meetings, self-help programs, and other therapeutic activities to enhance healing and promote lasting recovery. The center offers amenities such as 12 step programs, substance abuse treatment, residential drug rehab, and a variety of therapies including holistic, evidence-based practices, yoga, meditation, and art & nature therapy. The highly qualified staff is committed to supporting clients in their journey towards a fulfilling and healthy lifestyle.
